about: Cases for ConversationStats' counted and timed phrases in every app language, read by both OzenKitTests (ConversationStatsSharedCasesTests, Swift) and core ConversationStatsSharedCasesTest (Kotlin). function names the call: minutesText(input seconds), speakersText, linesText, wordsText, secondsText, aboutMinutesLeftText, oldConversationsDeletedText (input a count), paceText(input words per minute); starredLinesText and newLinesText are linesText with the adjective the app passes ("מסומנת"/"מסומנות" with englishAdjective "starred"; "חדשה"/"חדשות" with "new"). expected holds the answer in each app language, by UILanguage raw value. The expected answers were written from the Swift side and checked by the Kotlin one.
